prompt:
A wide establishing vista of London in a high-fantasy world — environment key art for a game world map, with no people.

The place: a radiant Gothic capital of a Western myth-world on a broad, shining river at a rose-gold dusk: along the riverbank a vast palace of honey-gold stone bristling with slender pinnacles and lace-like Gothic tracery, and at its end a soaring clock tower crowned with a gilded spire, its four great dials of glowing pearl-white glass ringed in gold and Prussian blue and a great bronze bell ringing in its open belfry; downstream twin Gothic gate towers of pale stone rising from the water, joined high up by two walkways, with blue-and-white chains sweeping down from them to the banks; on the riverbank an ancient white-walled fortress keep with crenellated battlements and four corner turrets; on a hill above the rooftops a great domed cathedral; stone bridges strung with lantern-orbs and silk banners, and a soft silver mist on the water.

Composition: a sweeping view from a high vantage point at a three-quarter angle, layered depth — framing elements in the near foreground, the city spread across the middle ground, mountains and sky far behind. The whole city reads at a glance as one memorable skyline. Keep the lower quarter of the picture calm and slightly darker (water, terrace or treetops without detail clutter) so interface cards can sit over it.

Style: painterly environment key art matching Korean MMORPG character artwork — 2D painting with visible brushwork, layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, a few crisp accents; rich atmospheric perspective and luminous light.

No people, no characters, no animals in focus; no text, letters, numbers, signs, logos or watermark; no frame or border.

Avoid: smartphone, mobile phone, plastic, LED screen, neon sign, neon, laptop, hologram, billboard, car, machinery, broadcast tower, TV tower, observation tower, skyscraper, Chinese-style palace, Great Wall, yellow-glazed roof tiles.

Output: one horizontal 3:2 image, 1536×1024.
